original_finding_content.subject: Capterra Spanish review — out of scope (date)
original_finding_content.raw_text:
**What:** Spanish-language seller review on Capterra praises Hotmart's publishing tools but criticizes system crashes and slow support response.  
**Verbatim snippet:** "Mi experiencia es buena ya que Hotmart como tiene sus defectos, es una plataforma bastante completa a la hora de querer dedicarte a la enseñanza."  
**Source:** https://www.capterra.com/p/219169/Hotmart/reviews/  
**source_type:** buyer_review  
**Notes:** Dated January 22, 2023. Outside April 2025–April 2026 window. Reviewer: anonymous, marketing and advertising professional. URL directly accessed.
